summary: Deployment fixes verified. All 46 backend tests pass (38 pre-existing regression + 8 new deployment-fix tests). Verified: (1) ALLOW_MOCK_ENTITLEMENT default is '0' in server.py, (2) POST /api/entitlement/mock returns 200 with flag=1 (current .env), (3) POST /api/entitlement/mock returns 404 when the env var is stripped and backend restarted, (4) GET /api/entitlement continues to work regardless of the flag, (5) app.json is valid JSON with expo.ios.bundleIdentifier=com.hyperintelligence.projectlife, usesAppleSignIn=true, android.package=com.hyperintelligence.projectlife, and 'expo-apple-authentication' in plugins, (6) /app/.gitignore has no standalone '.env' / '.env.*' / '*.env' lines, (7) frontend/.env has METRO_CACHE_ROOT wrapped in double quotes. backend/.env was restored to ALLOW_MOCK_ENTITLEMENT=1 after the 404 test and backend reheath-checked at /api/ -> 200.
critical_code_review_comments: Nice-to-have: consider surfacing whether the mock endpoint is exposed via an /api/config or health payload so ops can validate at runtime without env-var inspection.
seed_data_creation: No seed data required; test uses in-test minted Supabase-style JWT via conftest.make_jwt(). QA user data is wiped by session-scoped fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_deployment_fixes.py::TestEntitlementMockFlag::test_mock_endpoint_404_when_flag_removed temporarily rewrites /app/backend/.env and restarts supervisor's backend service. It restores the file in `finally` and re-checks /api/. If a future test also mutates backend/.env, be mindful of ordering — this test is safe to re-run standalone.
